---
title: "MVP Calculator"
format: html
---

<div id="mvp-ui">
  <h2>MVP weight editor</h2>
  <p>Change weights for normalized stats and click Compute to re-rank players client-side.</p>
  <div id="weights" style="margin-bottom:12px"></div>
  <button id="compute">Compute MVP</button>
  <button id="reset" style="margin-left:8px">Reset to defaults</button>
  <h3 style="margin-top:18px">Top candidates</h3>
  <div id="results"></div>
</div>

<script>
window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS = {
    "team_win_pct_norm": 0.41,
    "PTS_norm": 0.29,
    "AST_norm": 0.07,
    "STL_norm": 0.02,
    "TRB_norm": 0.06,
    "BLK_norm": 0.05,
    "TOV_norm": 0.01,
    "eFG%_norm": 0.04
  };

  function mkInputs(container, weights) {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    Object.keys(weights).forEach(k => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.margin = "6px 0";
      row.innerHTML = `
        <label style="min-width:240px;display:inline-block">${k}:</label>
        <input data-key="${k}" type="number" step="0.01" value="${weights[k]}">
      `;
      container.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function readWeights() {
    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll("#weights input");
    const w = {};
    inputs.forEach(i => w[i.dataset.key] = parseFloat(i.value) || 0);
    return w;
  }

  function computeMVP(players, weights) {
    return players.map(p => {
      let s = 0;
      for (const k in weights) {
        const val = p[k] ?? 0;
        s += (Number(val) || 0) * Number(weights[k]);
      }
      return { ...p, mvp_score: s };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.mvp_score - a.mvp_score);
  }

  function renderTable(players) {
    const top = players.slice(0, 10);
    const cols = ["MVP Rank","Player", "Team", "PTS", "AST", "TRB", "eFG%_norm", "mvp_score"];
    let html = "<table style='width:100%;border-collapse:collapse'><thead><tr>";
    cols.forEach(c => html += `<th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd">${c}</th>`);
    html += "</tr></thead><tbody>";

    top.forEach(r => {
      html += "<tr>";
      cols.forEach(c => {
        const v = r[c] === undefined ? "" : (c === "mvp_score" ? Number(r[c]).toFixed(4) : r[c]);
        html += `<td style="padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee">${v}</td>`;
      });
      html += "</tr>";
    });

    html += "</tbody></table>";
    document.getElementById("results").innerHTML = html;
  }

  fetch("./players.json")
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject("players.json not found"))
    .then(players => {
      mkInputs(document.getElementById("weights"), DEFAULT_WEIGHTS);

      document.getElementById("compute").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const weights = readWeights();
        const ranked = computeMVP(players, weights);
        renderTable(ranked);
      });

      document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
        mkInputs(document.getElementById("weights"), DEFAULT_WEIGHTS);
        renderTable(computeMVP(players, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS));
      });

      renderTable(computeMVP(players, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS));
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("mvp-ui").innerHTML = "<p style='color:red'>Error loading players.json. Make sure the JSON file was generated and included in the site build.</p>";
      console.error(err);
    });
});
</script>
